source: Test fixture — an entry whose every name carries an accent (issue #330)
description: The shipped knowledge base carries no alias above U+007F, so DrugReference.foldDiacritics takes its ASCII fast path and returns the alias unchanged: over that dataset a folded alias list is INDISTINGUISHABLE from the raw one, and a guard comparing the two proves nothing. This fixture is the one shape where the reference side of the fold is load-bearing — the shape containsBoundedToken's javadoc says it exists for, 'a hand-authored json KB may carry an accented alias' — so the entry deliberately carries NO unaccented sibling alias, unlike drug-reference-accented-tokens.json whose entries each carry one. An unaccented recorded name reaches this entry only if the alias really was folded.
